original_test_intent: Verify CPU information shown during POST and in the specified BIOS Processor Configuration page matches the approved CPU specification, with OS or approved RW-tool corroboration for missing cache fields.
original_method: Operator powers on, captures POST and BIOS path without changes; after boot, agent securely collects full raw dmidecode/lscpu/cache topology; engineer maps socket/model/core/thread/speed/cache fields to spec and records authority for unavailable fields.
manual_activity: Operator/KVM powers on, captures POST and specified BIOS screen; agent may collect secure OS evidence afterward.
required_inputs: Qualified operator/KVM and exact POST/BIOS capture method
Required socket/model/core/thread/speed/cache field matrix and tolerances
Approved RW-tool identity/version/method if specification omits L1/L2
Secure OS access, dmidecode/lscpu/cache tools, thermal/SEL abort and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not modify or save BIOS settings while inspecting
Use secure authenticated OS access only
Stop on POST/BIOS/thermal/SEL/boot error or wrong system
No automatic reboot, firmware/power/topology change or retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw dmidecode/lscpu/cache/topology after operator-approved boot
Build field-by-field BIOS/OS/spec comparison without verdict
Do not perform physical power button/KVM actions, claim screen observation, run unapproved RW tool or change BIOS
engineer_actions: Provide CPU spec and field authority
Approve RW tool if needed and ensure screen capture
Resolve BIOS/OS differences and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: OS inventory is useful but unsafe SSH/nested quoting and grep-only filtering are rejected; OS evidence cannot replace POST/BIOS screens.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After manual capture and boot, securely collect full `dmidecode -t processor`, `lscpu` and cache topology with raw DMI handles/labels.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: POST, Esc, BIOS path, specification comparison, optional RW tool and1/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture immutable POST/BIOS screens and reconcile every CPU field with raw OS evidence and approved field authority.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure evidence, raw field completeness, RW-tool provenance and safe BIOS exit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS DMI cannot prove what POST/BIOS displayed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware labels and SMBIOS values may differ; current speed is dynamic and cache fields may use different aggregation.

project_override_considerations: If CPU spec lacks L1/L2, project must name the RW tool/source and equivalence; no tool is inferred.
expected_evidence: dmesg/syslog/SEL, thermal state, exit-without-save and final health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: POST/BIOS information and CPU-spec criterion align. Missing field values and optional RW-tool identity are project readiness inputs rather than contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator/KVM, specification and tools can be supplied; manual firmware capture plus automated OS inventory is feasible.

review_improvement: Preserves POST/BIOS authority, rejects unsafe grep-only proof and makes optional RW-tool provenance auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: POST/BIOS display is the named coverage and may not match SMBIOS exactly, so OS data is corroboration rather than substitution. Grep can drop DMI handles or alternate labels, and an unspecified RW tool cannot become authority. Complete screen and raw records are needed to explain field-level differences.
